items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: John Hammond never liked the big bands, and he was my main backer

ctx.x: That's right. And those records. It's just unfortunate that recording companies only pressed a certain amount of jazz records in those days.

They never had the cooperation by the men behind the scenes. John Hammond never liked the big bands, and he was my main backer, and with him not supporting it, it died a natural death. We made about 20 sides for Columbia, and Columbia has never reissued those 78's, or never reissued them on LP ; but the excellent LP's have been issued and bootlegged in Europe.
